corridors._distance_note: approx from atoll coords; refine at BP build

_fare_record.currency_basis: USD (Maldives transfers natively USD; no FX, R8)
_fare_record.source: immaldives.com Maldives transfer costs (May 2026): shared speedboat $100-490 RT pp (=$50-245 OW); shared seaplane $400-820 RT pp (=$200-410 OW). atolltransfer.com scheduled $30-195 OW. Navier premium per-seat anchored between local premium speedboat and the seaplane the resort otherwise charges (R-MALDIVES-1).
_fare_record.method: R-MALDIVES-1: premium per-seat set between local premium speedboat ($50-245/way, immaldives 2026) and the seaplane the resort otherwise charges ($200-410/way). Beyond-Male atoll-gateway transfer.

_demand_record.source: Modeled arrivals = published keys x occupancy 0.70 (Maldives Min. of Tourism avg) x (365/6.5 nights avg stay) x 1.9 pax/room. Inbound one-way transfers. T5-modeled/med; keys T1 resort-published. NULL for pure inter-resort excursion legs (R2).
_demand_record.method: keys x occupancy 0.70 (Maldives Min. of Tourism avg) x (365 / 6.5 nights avg stay) x 1.9 pax/room = inbound one-way transfers/yr.

corridors.from: Velana International Airport (MLE) Resort Speedboat Lounges

_fare_record.currency_basis: USD (Maldives resort/seaplane transfers natively quoted in USD; no FX, R8-style)
_fare_record.source: COMO Hotels official (Tripadvisor FAQ quoting resort): private guest speedboat USD 250++ per person combined return = $125/way. maldivesnomad.com: COMO Cocoa Island $258 RT = $129/way. Private up-to-4-guest charter from ~$900/boat/way (Go Ocean Travel). Premium per-seat $130/way.
_fare_record.method: Two independent listings (COMO/Tripadvisor $250 RT; maldivesnomad $258 RT) agree. Premium per-seat $130/way. R1 satisfied.

_demand_record.source: Modeled from resort key count. COMO Cocoa Island (Makunufushi, South Malé): ~33 villas/keys (published resort/Virtuoso/booking figures). corridor_annual_oneway_pax = keys x 365 x occ(0.75) / avg_stay(7 nights) x guests/key(2) x 2 (arr+dep) ~= keys x 156. 33 keys -> ~5,200 one-way pax/yr. Airport(MLE)<->this resort is the sole transfer corridor (boat/seaplane only; no road/air alt - R3-EXCEPTION: arrivals = crossing ridership).
_demand_record.method: Resort-key-count occupancy model (R2: grounded key count, not a blind guess; banded low-med). Avg-stay 7 nights, occ 0.75, 2 guests/occupied key.
